title: Lifetime paid spend
prompt: Return customer_id,full_name,spend_cents for ALL customers, including zero spend. Only count paid order lines; sort spend DESC,customer_id.

title: Monthly paid revenue
prompt: Return month (YYYY-MM),revenue_cents from paid item lines, ascending by month.

title: Latest paid order per customer
prompt: Return customer_id,order_id,ordered_at of the latest paid order for each paying customer; date DESC,id DESC tie-break; sort customer_id.

title: Top two salaries by team
prompt: Return team_name,employee,salary_cents for top 2 employees per team; tie-break employee_id; sort team_name,salary DESC,employee_id.

title: Last order incl inactive buyers
prompt: Return customer_id,full_name,last_order_date for every customer (NULL if no orders), sorted customer_id.

title: Products selling >2 units
prompt: Return sku,paid_units for products with >2 units on paid orders, ordered units DESC,sku.

title: Above-team-average earners
prompt: Return team_name,employee,salary_cents for employees above their team's average salary. Sort team_name,salary DESC,employee_id.

title: Order status counts per customer
prompt: Return customer_id,paid_count,pending_count,cancelled_count for every customer including zero orders, sorted customer_id.

title: Products with zero paid sales
prompt: Return sku,product_name of products never referenced by PAID order lines (pending/cancelled do not count); sort sku.

title: Running monthly revenue
prompt: Return month,revenue_cents,running_cents based on paid line totals, sorted month ASC.

title: First paid date
prompt: Return customer_id,first_paid_date for paying customers, sorted customer_id.

title: Revenue by category
prompt: Return category_name,revenue_cents for ALL categories including zero revenue; based on paid line totals. Sort revenue DESC then category_name.

title: Rank category revenue
prompt: Return category_name,revenue_cents,revenue_rank using DENSE_RANK from highest revenue (include empty categories), sort rank then name.

title: Customers both paid and pending
prompt: Return customer_id for customers with at least one paid and one pending order, sorted ASC.

title: Cumulative spend per buyer
prompt: Return customer_id,order_id,running_cents for paid orders in customer,date,id order, sorted customer_id,ordered_at,order_id.
hint: Aggregate per paid order before running total.

title: Active products by category
prompt: Return category_name,active_products for all categories including zero products, sorted name.
